# jsVectorMap 1.7.0

Unmodified browser distribution of [jsVectorMap](https://github.com/themustafaomar/jsvectormap), licensed under the MIT license. Copyright (c) 2020 Mustafa Omar. The complete license is included in `LICENSE`.

Vendored on 2026-10-13 from the pinned npm release via jsDelivr:

- `jsvectormap.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsvectormap@1.7.0/dist/jsvectormap.min.js
- `jsvectormap.min.css`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsvectormap@1.7.0/dist/jsvectormap.min.css
- `LICENSE`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsvectormap@1.7.0/LICENSE

The JavaScript is a browser-ready UMD bundle exposing `window.jsVectorMap`. These files are hosted locally with the site; no CDN connection or build step is needed at runtime.
